required_acceptance.requirement: Exact v3.1e baseline is imported without unreviewed semantic changes.
DraftGarment supports edit category/label/photo before Outfit commit.
Cancel/Back during DraftGarment edit restores prior draft values.
Stale async photo completion cannot mutate a closed/canceled DraftGarment edit.
DraftGarment edit never commits a Garment before parent Outfit save.
Exact duplicate decision exposes Keep editing/Open saved outfit/Save another version.
Closing/Back from duplicate decision is non-destructive and equivalent to Keep editing.
Open saved outfit discards only the duplicate draft and opens the existing committed Outfit.
Save another version intentionally commits another Outfit.
Duplicate decision instrumentation records all three choices without free-text/media.
All existing v3.1e regression invariants remain green.
Sanitized evidence still excludes photo bytes, short labels, and practical-note text.
Repository provides one deterministic verification entrypoint.
Mutation/negative controls remain capable of detecting protected invariant breakage.
Any runtime/manual/device claims remain HOLD until actually executed in that environment.
